selection_rule: First two registered questions per category, repeat 0, both modes. Selected before reviewing these final answers.
criteria: Key savings conditions consistent with available source evidence
Introductory, base and conditional rates distinguished when discussed
Digital-bank awards not treated as proof of better savings returns
Material unsupported or contradictory claims recorded; outside-corpus facts marked unverified rather than passed
scope: Qualitative spot check, not a population accuracy certificate. No configuration will be tuned on these validation answers.
